inference.note: socratic-predict accepts only operating_threshold (the shipped point) and postprocessor_threshold (the T=0.35 input that socratic-repair, socratic-continuity and socratic-sheet-patches pin); no other threshold was preregistered. device and max_cpu_threads are operator-overridable defaults, the device type is pinned, and every other key is a pin.
